# Document sharing requirements (fixture, fictional)

- R01 Roles: Owner, Editor, Viewer.
- R02 Owners can share a document and change roles.
- R03 Editors can share with Viewer access only.
- R04 Viewers cannot share; tapping "Share" shows a "Request edit access" option that notifies the owner.
- R05 If the owner removes someone's access while they have the document open, they see "You no longer have access".
